sources.title: Wikipedia: William McKinley
sources.description: President of the United States from 1897 to 1901

notes.text: William McKinley was the 25th president of the United States, serving from 1897 until his assassination in 1901.

William McKinley successfully led the US in the Spanish–American War and oversaw a period of American expansionism, with the annexations of Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Philippines, and American Samoa.
William McKinley is remembered as a politician connected with United States.
William McKinley's recorded life dates place this profile around 1843-1901.
William McKinley is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
